story_text: As a user, I want the login endpoint to return an error when the email field is empty so that I provide all required credentials.

positive.title: Return error when email field is empty during login request
steps: 1. Send a login request with an empty email field
positive.expected_result: The login endpoint returns an error message indicating that the email field is required, and the user is not authenticated.

positive.title: Display appropriate validation message for empty email field during login
steps: 1. Send a login request with an empty email field
positive.expected_result: The system displays a validation message indicating that the email field is required.

negative.title: System accepts empty email as valid input
steps: 1. Send a login request with an empty email field
negative.expected_result: The system should return an error message indicating that the email field is required.

negative.title: API returns success response despite empty email field
steps: 1. Send a login request with an empty email field
negative.expected_result: The API should return an error message indicating that the email field is required.

edge.title: Submit login request with email field containing only spaces
steps: 1. Send a login request with the email field containing only whitespace characters
edge.expected_result: The system should return an error message indicating that the email field is required and cannot contain only whitespace.

edge.title: Submit login request with empty email and empty password
steps: 1. Send a login request with an empty email field
edge.expected_result: The system should return an error message indicating that both the email and password fields are required.

edge.title: Submit login request with empty email field multiple times rapidly
steps: 1. Send a login request with an empty email field
3. Repeat the login request with an empty email field multiple times in quick succession.
edge.expected_result: The system should return an error message indicating that the email field is required.
